_comment: Background music for the launch videos (scripts/score.mjs). Audio is Mixkit Stock Music Free License (https://mixkit.co/license/#musicFree): use in social video is allowed, redistributing the files is not, so they live git-ignored in public/music/ (pnpm fetch:music). offset = source seconds of the downbeat that lands on t=0; tempo = atempo ratio (120 / bpm) so beats fall on the 0.5 s cut grid; fades in seconds, the fade-out ends at exactly `duration`. Offsets were measured on the files with these sha256 sums.

better-times.title: Better Times are Coming
better-times.note: bars 25-39 (bar = 2 s): groove from t=0, riser 20-22 s, full drums return at 22 s, ends on a 4-bar line

south-waves.title: South Waves
south-waves.note: bars 65-79: steady loop section, 8-bar line at 14 s, ends where the last breakdown starts

mountains.title: Mountains
mountains.note: bars 113-127: last full phrase before the outro, 8-bar line at 14 s, drum fill at 20 s

swish-swed.title: Swish Swed
swish-swed.note: bars 53-67: final drop, 8-bar line at 14 s, ends where the song ends

deep-urban.title: Deep Urban
deep-urban.note: bars 73-87: bassline groove, full section (+2.5 dB) lands at 22 s, ends on a 4-bar line

techno-fest-vibes.title: Techno Fest Vibes
techno-fest-vibes.note: bars 25-39: 8-bar phrases with fills at 12 s and 20 s, ends at the next section
